comment: Differences between babel.dates (CLDR 47) and ICU4C (78.2, CLDR 48) that come from the data, not the code: each disappears when babel.dates is built from CLDR 48's data (tests/icu/README.md). Keys: operation, field (pattern, style, skeleton, or unit/width) and locale. tests/icu/check_icu.py fails on a difference not listed here and on a listed one that no longer occurs.
icu_pattern EEEE d MMMM y G bn: CLDR 48 changed bn's spellings: জানুয়ারী to জানুয়ারি, the abbreviated month অক্টো, ঘন্টা to ঘণ্টা
icu_pattern EEEE d MMMM y G fi: CLDR 48 changed fi's format weekday names to the essive ('sunnuntaina')
icu_pattern LLL LLLL MMMMM bn: CLDR 48 changed bn's spellings: জানুয়ারী to জানুয়ারি, the abbreviated month অক্টো, ঘন্টা to ঘণ্টা
icu_pattern VVV en: CLDR 48 renamed the unknown city (Etc/Unknown) to an unknown location ('Unknown Location', 'lieu inconnu')
